title: Why Did Investors Call Their Money a "Donation"?

lines.say: Why would an investor call his money a donation? Because, prosecutors say, the pastor told him to.
lines.show: Why would an investor call his money a "donation"? Because, prosecutors say, the pastor told him to.

lines.say: Richard Garcia sold church flipping and concert deals, and had victims label payments as donations to Gracia Church.
lines.show: Richard Garcia sold church flipping and concert deals, and had victims label payments as "donations" to Gracia Church.

scene.src: USAO N.D. Tex. press release, Nov 20, 2026

lines.say: One investor even got a donation letter, the indictment says, for money meant for church deals.
lines.show: One investor even got a Donation Letter, the indictment says, for money meant for church deals.

scene.src: Superseding Indictment, U.S. v. Garcia (N.D. Tex. 4:26-cr-146, Dkt. 35)

lines.say: More than seventy victims. More than six million dollars. A jury found Garcia guilty on November nineteenth.
lines.show: More than 70 victims. More than $6 million. A jury found Garcia guilty on November 19.
